capabilities: create a note for a named anime with synopsis, tags, and a link to its page
create character pages in a per-anime folder via a selection modal
configure the anime list path, tags, checklist setting, and a custom template
extras: One roadmap item (adding characters to the page) was replaced by a separate character folder approach, marked with a strikethrough in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create notes populated with anime data like synopsis, tags, and character information from MyAnimeList.

relations.evidence: This plugin creates a page in Obsidian from your anime list.

summary: Anime note creator that generates a note for an anime with data, synopsis, tags, links, and optional character pages using the Jikan API.
